## Purpose

The mutation status of the lines comes from DepMap 24Q4, which sequenced its
own stocks. The metabolomics data were measured on the stocks of Cherkaoui
et al. (2022). Cell lines evolve in culture, so the stocks can differ.
This notebook asks, for the genes of the pre-specified contrasts (KRAS, MTAP,
STK11, KEAP1, NFE2L2, TP53), how well the independent sources agree and how
clear DepMap's calls are. Allele fractions and copy number serve as an
additional check only; no line is removed on that basis.

**Decision supported:** whether the DepMap status of these genes can be used
as the genotype of the measured lines, and which limitation is reported.

## Inputs

- `data/derived/cancer-cell-lines/shorthouse_v1/shorthouse_analysis_v1.rds` (lines used in models, DepMap status)
- `data/derived/cancer-cell-lines/shorthouse_v1/02_cell_lines.tsv`, `02_gene_status.tsv` (Cellosaurus, release 53.0)
- `data/derived/cancer-cell-lines/shorthouse_v1/04_depmap_models.tsv`, `04_copy_number.rds` (DepMap model per line, copy number)
- `data/raw/cancer-cell-lines/depmap_24Q4/OmicsSomaticMutations.csv` (allele fractions; local only)
- `data/raw/cancer-cell-lines/shorthouse_github/Mutations_in_celllines.csv`: mutation calls used by Shorthouse et al. (**local only**, no licence)

## Methods

Three sources were compared on the lines used in models: DepMap 24Q4, the
variations listed by Cellosaurus, and the CCLE/COSMIC/NCI-60 calls used by
Shorthouse et al. To compare like with like, a line counted as mutated in
each source if it carried a protein-changing (non-silent) variant in the gene,
regardless of the definition used in the contrasts. Lines without any entry in
a source were treated as not covered by that source, not as wild type.
Agreement was counted on the lines covered by all three sources. Cellosaurus
lists selected, published variants, so a "DepMap only" call is expected more
often than a "Cellosaurus only" call.

For DepMap, the allele fraction (AF) of each variant was inspected:
heterozygous variants in a clonal population lie near 0.5 and homozygous or
LOH variants near 1, and clearly lower values indicate a subclonal variant.
For MTAP, a deletion gene, absolute copy number was inspected instead
(0 = homozygous deletion).

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

source(here::here("analyses/cancer-cell-lines/R/use_case.R"))
source(here::here("analyses/cancer-cell-lines/R/plotting.R"))
source(here::here("analyses/cancer-cell-lines/R/cellosaurus.R"))
config <- load_config()
raw_dir <- uc_dir(config, "raw")
derived_dir <- uc_dir(config, "derived")
fig_dir <- uc_dir(config, "output", "audit_08_genotype_reliability")

# genes of the pre-specified contrasts and their covariates (D22)
mutation_genes <- c("KRAS", "STK11", "KEAP1", "NFE2L2", "TP53")
deletion_genes <- c("MTAP", "CDKN2A")

# lines used in models
analysis_data <- readRDS(file.path(derived_dir, "shorthouse_analysis_v1.rds"))
lines <- analysis_data$lines %>% filter(in_models) %>% select(line, tissue)
nrow(lines)
```

## 1. Mutation calls in the three sources

```{r sources}
# DepMap: variants per line and gene (step 04); splice-site variants have no
# protein change, so presence is taken from the row, not from protein_changes
depmap <- analysis_data$mutation_status %>%
    filter(line %in% lines$line, gene %in% mutation_genes) %>%
    transmute(line, gene, in_depmap = TRUE, depmap_variants = protein_changes, likely_driver)

# Cellosaurus: entries of status "mutation"; lines with any entry count as covered
cell_lines <- readr::read_tsv(file.path(derived_dir, "02_cell_lines.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
gene_status <- readr::read_tsv(file.path(derived_dir, "02_gene_status.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
cellosaurus_covered <- intersect(lines$line, gene_status$line)
cellosaurus <- gene_status %>%
    filter(line %in% cellosaurus_covered, gene %in% mutation_genes, status == "mutation") %>%
    group_by(line, gene) %>%
    summarise(cellosaurus_variants = paste(unique(variants), collapse = "; "), .groups = "drop")

# CCLE calls used by Shorthouse et al.; non-silent variants; names matched as in audit/04
calls <- readr::read_csv(file.path(raw_dir, "shorthouse_github", "Mutations_in_celllines.csv"),
                         show_col_types = FALSE, name_repair = "unique_quiet")
cellosaurus_entries <- read_cellosaurus(file.path(raw_dir, config$cellosaurus$file))$entries
normalise <- function(x) toupper(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "", x))
call_names <- tibble(name = unique(calls$CellLineName_Cellosaurus)) %>%
    mutate(line = cell_lines$line[match(normalise(name), normalise(cell_lines$cellosaurus_name))])
fallback <- map_names_to_accessions(call_names$name[is.na(call_names$line)], cellosaurus_entries)
call_names <- call_names %>%
    left_join(select(fallback, name, ac), by = "name") %>%
    mutate(line = coalesce(line, cell_lines$line[match(ac, cell_lines$accession)])) %>%
    filter(!is.na(line)) %>%
    select(name, line)
calls <- inner_join(calls, call_names, by = c("CellLineName_Cellosaurus" = "name"))
ccle_covered <- intersect(lines$line, calls$line)
ccle <- calls %>%
    filter(line %in% ccle_covered, HGNC %in% mutation_genes,
           MutationType %in% c("Missense", "Nonsense", "Frame_Shift", "In_Frame") |
               grepl("Splice_Site", MutationType_Raw)) %>%
    group_by(line, gene = HGNC) %>%
    summarise(ccle_variants = paste(unique(na.omit(AA_Mutation)), collapse = "; "), .groups = "drop")

c(lines = nrow(lines), cellosaurus_covered = length(cellosaurus_covered),
  ccle_covered = length(ccle_covered),
  all_three = length(intersect(cellosaurus_covered, ccle_covered)))

# one row per covered line and gene, with the call of each source
comparison <- tidyr::expand_grid(line = intersect(cellosaurus_covered, ccle_covered), gene = mutation_genes) %>%
    left_join(depmap, by = c("line", "gene")) %>%
    left_join(cellosaurus, by = c("line", "gene")) %>%
    left_join(ccle, by = c("line", "gene")) %>%
    mutate(
        D = coalesce(in_depmap, FALSE), C = !is.na(cellosaurus_variants), E = !is.na(ccle_variants),
        agreement = case_when(
            D & C & E ~ "all three",
            !D & !C & !E ~ "none",
            D & E ~ "DepMap + CCLE calls",
            D & C ~ "DepMap + Cellosaurus",
            C & E ~ "not DepMap",
            D ~ "DepMap only",
            TRUE ~ "not DepMap"
        )
    ) %>%
    left_join(lines, by = "line")

comparison %>%
    count(gene, agreement) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = agreement, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
```

```{r sources-plot, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 3.5}
agreement_levels <- c("all three", "DepMap + CCLE calls", "DepMap + Cellosaurus", "DepMap only", "not DepMap")
p <- comparison %>%
    filter(agreement != "none") %>%
    mutate(agreement = factor(agreement, levels = agreement_levels)) %>%
    count(gene, agreement) %>%
    ggplot(aes(n, gene, fill = agreement)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = uc_palette(agreement_levels)) +
    labs(x = "Mutated lines", y = NULL, fill = NULL,
         title = "Mutation calls by source",
         subtitle = "lines used in models and covered by all three sources") +
    theme_uc()
save_figure(p, "agreement", fig_dir, height = 3.5)
p
```

Lines where the sources disagree, with the variants each source reports:

```{r discordant}
comparison %>%
    filter(!agreement %in% c("all three", "none")) %>%
    select(gene, line, tissue, agreement, depmap_variants, likely_driver, cellosaurus_variants, ccle_variants) %>%
    arrange(gene, agreement, line) %>%
    preview_table(caption = "Lines where the sources disagree")
```

## 2. Allele fractions of the DepMap variants

```{r allele-fraction}
# DepMap model per line (step 04)
model_of_line <- readr::read_tsv(file.path(derived_dir, "04_depmap_models.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(line %in% lines$line, !is.na(ModelID)) %>%
    select(line, ModelID)

# variants of the genes with allele fraction and driver flags
flag_columns <- c("Hotspot", "LikelyLoF", "HessDriver", "OncogeneHighImpact", "TumorSuppressorHighImpact")
variants <- data.table::fread(
    file.path(raw_dir, config$depmap$dir, "OmicsSomaticMutations.csv"),
    select = c("ModelID", "HugoSymbol", "VariantInfo", "ProteinChange", "AF", "DP", flag_columns)
) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    filter(HugoSymbol %in% mutation_genes) %>%
    inner_join(model_of_line, by = "ModelID") %>%
    mutate(likely_driver = Hotspot | LikelyLoF | HessDriver | OncogeneHighImpact | TumorSuppressorHighImpact) %>%
    select(line, gene = HugoSymbol, VariantInfo, ProteinChange, AF, DP, likely_driver)

# variant classes counted as "mutated" (any variant listed by DepMap, D19)
count(variants, gene, VariantInfo) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = gene, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

variants %>%
    group_by(gene) %>%
    summarise(variants = n(), lines = n_distinct(line),
              median_AF = median(AF), AF_below_0.25 = sum(AF < 0.25), median_depth = median(DP))
preview_table(arrange(variants, gene, AF), caption = "DepMap variants with allele fraction")
```

```{r allele-fraction-plot, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 3.5}
p <- variants %>%
    mutate(driver = if_else(likely_driver, "likely driver", "other")) %>%
    ggplot(aes(AF, gene, colour = driver)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(0.5, 1), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey70") +
    geom_jitter(height = 0.2, width = 0, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = uc_palette(c("likely driver", "other"))) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(x = "Allele fraction (DepMap)", y = NULL, colour = NULL,
         title = "Allele fractions of the variants in the lines used in models") +
    theme_uc()
save_figure(p, "allele_fraction", fig_dir, height = 3.5)
p
```

## 3. Copy number of MTAP and CDKN2A

```{r copy-number, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 3.5}
# absolute copy number per line (step 04); 0 = homozygous deletion
copy_number <- readRDS(file.path(derived_dir, "04_copy_number.rds"))
cn <- copy_number[intersect(rownames(copy_number), lines$line), deletion_genes, drop = FALSE] %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("line") %>%
    pivot_longer(-line, names_to = "gene", values_to = "copy_number")
cn %>% group_by(gene) %>%
    summarise(lines = n(), deleted = sum(copy_number == 0), between_0_and_1 = sum(copy_number > 0 & copy_number < 1))

p <- ggplot(cn, aes(copy_number)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.25, boundary = 0, fill = uc_palette("lines")) +
    facet_wrap(~gene) +
    labs(x = "Absolute copy number (DepMap)", y = "Lines",
         title = "Copy number of the 9p21 genes in the lines used in models") +
    theme_uc()
save_figure(p, "copy_number_9p21", fig_dir, height = 3.5)
p

# Cellosaurus entries for the two genes, for comparison
gene_status %>%
    filter(line %in% lines$line, gene %in% deletion_genes) %>%
    count(gene, status)
```

## Interpretation

On the 158 lines covered by all three sources:

- **The driver calls agree.** KRAS: 41 of 42 mutated lines in all three
  sources; the remaining line (RXF393, kidney) is mutated only in the CCLE
  calls. NFE2L2: the five lung lines are identical in DepMap and the CCLE calls,
  with the same protein change (Cellosaurus lists none). TP53: 119 lines in
  all three. KEAP1 and STK11: DepMap and the CCLE calls agree on the exact
  protein change in 13 and 16 lines; Cellosaurus lists few of them.
- **"DepMap only" calls are mostly weak.** KEAP1 has 5 and STK11 has 6, and
  most of them are variants DepMap does not flag as drivers. Several have low
  allele fractions or depths (CALU3 STK11 AF 0.18 at depth 10, SW780 STK11
  0.23, NCIH661 KEAP1 0.25), consistent with subclonal variants or noise.
  Under D19 these lines count as altered; see caveat 21.
- **Allele fractions are otherwise clear.** For KEAP1, STK11 and TP53 the
  median AF is close to 1 (loss of the other allele). For the activating
  genes it is lower (KRAS 0.78, NFE2L2 0.54), as expected for heterozygous
  gain-of-function variants. Only 5 of 243 variants have AF < 0.25.
- **One line has no DepMap mutation calls at all.** NCIH1755 (lung) is
  matched to a DepMap model (ACH-000282), but that model has no rows in the
  24Q4 mutation file. It was therefore read as wild type for every gene,
  although Cellosaurus and the CCLE calls report TP53 C242F and the CCLE calls
  also report KEAP1 E582\* and STK11 P281fs. **Fixed (D24):** lines without
  DepMap mutation calls are no longer used in mutation models, so NCIH1755 no
  longer appears in the tables above (the finding came from the first render).
- **30 lines in models have no DepMap copy number** (10 lung, 8 breast). They
  were treated as "not deleted". This mattered for the MTAP deletion contrast,
  where these lines would have entered the non-deleted group without evidence.
  **Fixed (D25):** MTAP is evaluated only on lines with copy number; for
  tumour suppressors, missing copy number still counts as not deleted, since
  KEAP1, STK11 and TP53 are homozygously deleted in only 1–2 of 137 lines.
- Three other TP53 discordances (A704, HT1197, PANC0327) are listed by
  Cellosaurus (A704 also by the CCLE calls) but not by DepMap, which has
  mutation calls for these models.
- MTAP and CDKN2A copy number is clearly bimodal: 34 and 51 lines at 0, and
  only 4 lines each between 0 and 1.

**Limitation (for the manuscript).** The genotypes are those of the DepMap
stocks, not of the stocks that were measured. Cherkaoui et al. (2022) state
that "Cell lines were maintained according to standard protocols, their
identity verified via STR sequencing and tested for mycoplasma infections".
STR profiling confirms identity, but not the mutation status. Cell lines grown
in different laboratories can differ genetically (Ben-David U et al. Genetic
and transcriptional evolution alters cancer cell line drug response.
*Nature* 2018. doi:10.1038/s41586-018-0409-3, PMID 30089904).
